channel.title: AI GridWatch — Ohio data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Ohio, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Plain City: data center moratorium — Enacted
Mount Vernon: data center moratorium — Enacted
Massillon: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 180-day moratorium (expired Aug 14). Replaced by permanent zoning rules voted 7-1 on Aug 3: data centers restricted to I-2 industrial zones, 400 ft minimum from residential, utility capacity certification and noise limits required

item.title: Boardman: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium to study regulation and zoning changes

item.title: Ohio (ballot measure): data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Conserve Ohio's proposed constitutional amendment to ban data centers over 25 MW gathered only ~70,000 of the required 413,488 signatures by the Jul 1 deadline. Organizers plan to try again for the 2027 ballot

item.title: Lordstown: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium (converted from outright ban after lawsuit). Developer Bristolville 25 LLC sued over \$3.6B, 1.65M sq ft project on former GM Lordstown Assembly site near OpenAI Stargate

item.title: Ravenna: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, unanimous. Nearly 100 residents packed the special meeting. Resident's 4-minute speech against a proposed data center near UH Portage Medical Center went viral (250K+ views on X)

item.title: Boardman Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium, unanimous. Pause for zoning regulation development

item.title: Painesville Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on new data center permits, unanimous

item.title: Vienna Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Rolling moratorium — originally enacted 2025, extended 60 days through Oct 16 while zoning solutions including noise and power limits are developed. Bitdeer (Singapore-based) has plans in area

item.title: Weathersfield Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium. Bitdeer plans a data center on Belmont Ave on land where an Ohio Edison power plant once operated

item.title: South Bloomfield: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Preventive ban — eliminated all industrial zoning preemptively to block data center applications. No developer had approached

item.title: Ohio (tax exemptions): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Governor's moratorium on data center tax exemptions while Joint Data Center Committee holds hearings. Two last data centers received \$42M in exemptions before the pause took effect

item.title: Ohio (ballot measure): data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Proposed constitutional amendment to ban data centers >25 MW failed to qualify — collected ~70,000 of 413,488 required signatures. Backers plan to try again for 2027 ballot

item.title: Athens: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year permit pause inside city limits; the mayor or service-safety director may extend it a second year. Does not reach the site that prompted it — that parcel is in Athens Township, outside the city

item.title: Vienna Township (Trumbull Co.): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Extended 60 days, Aug 16 to Oct 16, 2026, while the county planning commission reviews the township's draft data center zoning
